message.content: {"reason": "Validation accuracy saturates at ~0.743 because both base learners only see high-cardinality interaction keys via arbitrary integer codes; the OOF blend search finding a nontrivial weight/threshold confirms the two models share the same representational gap rather than an ensembling problem. Leakage-safe out-of-fold smoothed target encoding directly converts conditional acceptance rates (coupon×occupation, coupon×time, etc.) into a dense numeric signal usable by both the DCN-MoE and the HistGradientBoosting learner, so the fix belongs in feature engineering plus the fold/bundle wiring. The similar historical TE attempt failed largely on OOF-fold ownership and persistence semantics, so the refinement keeps fold-safe encoding construction, appends TE as an extra numeric block (rather than destroying existing categorical embeddings), and makes the bundle the single source of truth at predict time.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Extend CouponFeatureEngineer with a smoothed target encoder (smoothing m=20, encoding = (sum_y + prior*m)/(count + m)) over the schema categoricals (coupon, occupation, education, income, age, maritalStatus, gender, and the FREQ_COLS venue fields) plus the high-cardinality interaction keys coupon×occupation, coupon×time, coupon×expiration, coupon×temperature, coupon×income, and age×maritalStatus; store maps_, prior_, m, and te_col_names on the engineer so they serialize with the bundle. WHY: These low-to-25-level fields and their conditional crosses carry strong acceptance signal that is currently destroyed by ordinal/ID coding, which forces the GBDT to split on meaningless integer thresholds and gives the NN only indirect signal through 8-dim embeddings; the historical failed TE attempt shows the representation gap is the real ceiling, and historical successes show that persisting all fitted state in the bundle is what prevents leakage and fresh-process failures. HOW: add fit_target_encoding(df, y, fold_ids, m=20) that builds per-key count/sum tables from training rows only and assigns each row an encoding computed from the other folds (row's own label never contributes), plus transform_target_encoding(df) that applies saved maps with unseen/NaN categories falling back to prior_; expose the encoded values as an additional numeric block appended to fe.num_cols_ ordering (do NOT remove existing categoricals, so the NN embedding cards and CategoricalIndexer vocabulary remain unchanged), and keep _to_tensors, _gbdt_matrix, feature_order_, num_cols_/cat_cols_, and fill_values_ contracts intact so downstream code continues to work.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Wire the leakage-free target encoding into the existing 5-fold StratifiedKFold (random_state=42) loop, the multi-seed N_REFIT full-data refit, bundle persistence, and the read-only predict path, without changing the fold split, seeds (SEED, SEED+fold, SEED+100+s, SEED+777), NN architecture (CouponDCNMoE cfg), GBDT_CFG, blend weight/threshold grids, label mapping, or row_id/prediction output format. WHY: TE features are only valid if trained rows see out-of-fold encodings derived from their fold's training rows while validation and ensemble models use maps fit on all training rows; the historical failed TE case was a wiring/persistence problem, not a representation problem, so the bundle must carry maps_, prior_, m, and te_col_names and predict must reload rather than refit. HOW: in run_train, after fitting CouponFeatureEngineer().fit(features.iloc[tr]) also call fit_target_encoding(...) using the existing fold tr indices, transform tr_out and va_out with the saved maps for that fold, and pass the same engineered matrix (numeric incl. TE block + unchanged categorical codes) to both _to_tensors and _gbdt_matrix so NN and GBDT see identical features; after OOF/blend/threshold tuning, refit the TE maps on all training rows for the full-data models and the GBDT ensemble. Extend the persisted bundle dict with the TE state (already carried via fe) plus any TE column names, and in run_predict load the bundle, call transform_target_encoding with saved maps only (never fit), fall back to stored prior_ for unseen categories, then rebuild NN tensors and the GBDT matrix from the same column order before applying the blend, threshold, and original-label mapping, keeping row_id = 0..N-1 in authoritative input order."}}
